title: Behavior Share Items
description: Allows the mob to give items it has to others.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

entity_types.description: Entity types the entity will share items with.

goal_radius.description: Distance in blocks at which the entity is considered to have reached the recipient.

max_dist.description: Maximum distance in blocks at which the entity will share items.

speed_multiplier.description: Movement speed multiplier while moving to share items.
